svg.text: Valley map. DRAFT revision 9, 2026-09-30, Sable (PLAN 8.13). Land hides the fire; boundaries come from the land. For Marlow's recheck.
Plan 1.5 px per m, north up. Origin south-west, x east, z north, heights absolute. Numbers and the leg-by-leg walk: Docs/Design/Valley.md rev 9. Places not drawn stay as Main3.md rev 16.
FIRE, hidden by land: valley fires x -110 to -220 (tops 20); far front x -240 to -400, z -150 to 650 (tops 105)
west face, cliff to the floor at -40 by x -40
old 400 x 300 m box (no wall on it)
W foot rock band 4 m+, face 50 deg+ above
north fir wall, 25 m deep, firs 8-24 ragged, 5 giants, deadfall and brush at its foot
south shore closed: brush to the water
NORTH LOOP, Camp 1 to J, about 235 m

g.text: stack top sees the gate T
RUIN: stovepipe, roof slab; door SW

svg.text: fence x 396, tied into both rock bands
ditches, reflector posts, power poles; curves away at z 430 and -130

g.text: crest line; land hides the fire
rock band: a boundary you can see
grove: giants tall, tops 50 or lower
event site E, search spot SS
forage A, B, C (two bear each day)
IW1 gate opening: stops leaving by the front
IW2 chute mouth, 3 m between boulders, by day;
the only gap in the W foot rock band
IW3 spur mouth, shift only; the loop is ringed by brush
Ward climb, night: camp to end 345 m, 138 s
Camp to J 80. Approach 20 to the chain at the chute.
L1 boulder chute, W, 34 m, 12 to 30, steps; the seep
L2 exposed shelf, N, 60 m, 30 to 41, scree; rune post
L3 burned cwm, NW, 45 m, 41 to 52, ash; split snag
L4 under the wall, S, 43 m, 52 to 60, needles; bent fir;
firs screen the valley, crest wall blocks the fire
P4 60, look-back east: cab, cabin, highway
cleft 24.5 m: dogleg 6 m in, fin at the mouth
ledge 21 m: the fire; end 1.5 m from the lip, stones left
M1 store (own level) M2 gate booth M3 office: west door
into the front room, back room east M4 car
M5 payphone + card table M6 the canvas you enter
M7 fishing M8 step, bowl, chair M9 Camp 1 table
M10 cave side room E1 woodpile E2 R1 day-1 spot
E3 Hollow Giant E5 fee booth phone E6 bucket
E9 Snag line E10 verge tree (deck frame, hard)
E11 ruin SS1-3 search spots E15 lamppost E16 SW light

svg.text: Section B: due west from the tower (z 166) to the fire. Horizontal 0.9 px per m, vertical 2 px per m (2.2x).
night 1 on: columns to 250, lit only below 130
day-1 sheet streaming west, top 60 to 110

g.text: Deck eye to the nearest flame top: 75.1 at the crest.
Land 80 blocks it: 1.9 m with eye and target +3 (1.5 at jump).
Day-1 sheet top: 69.4 at the crest, land blocks by 7.6 (+3).

svg.text: Section A: tower to the Ward stones (bearing 290).
Horizontal 2.6 px per m, vertical 3 px per m.

g.text: Deck eye to stone tops: 68.2 at the knob's east edge.
Knob 84 across x 8 to 20, z 200 to 245: 12.8 m with +3.
The tower sees the knob every day, never what is on it.
Ledge 62 and stones stand above the deck (56).

svg.text: Paper figures. F-1 is a ray test on land with eye and target raised 3 m; trees never count. Every daytime eye is listed in Valley.md 7. Then W-1, C-1, E-1 and the eye-height gate (DECISIONS 2026-09-30).
Heights rev 8 to rev 9: W crest 64-70 to 80 (saddle 74, z -10); knob 74 to 84; ledge 62; climb 292 m, 117 s to 265 m, 106 s; camp to the Ward 345 m, 138 s. Sable.
